test_title: PYST 26: Selection Post (Graduate Level) - English Language (Held On 29 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Convert the sentence provided below from its passive voice structure to an active voice structure:**

The data had been being compiled for weeks before the report.

options.text: They were compiling the data for weeks before the report.
They had been compiling the data for weeks before the report.
They had compiled the data for weeks before the report.
They had been compiled the data for weeks.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Passive to Active Voice Conversion:** When converting, the unstated agent in the passive sentence (often represented as "They" or "Someone") becomes the subject of the active sentence.
 
• The original sentence is in the **Past Perfect Continuous Tense**
